description: Phase 3: creates ONE semantic element plus its view node from the notation palette (or the non-drag insert) as a single undo/redo step - never a diagram node without a model element. The forward batch (add_element + set_view_node) is applied by the shared ModelingOperationEngine under the Authoring policy, so a notation rule or an invalid container fails exactly as modeling_apply_operations would; the editor validates the same batch on a clone before pushing the command. Undo is a lossless rollback of exactly what the command added.
